Title: array nntp_get (
Description:
nntp_get() is used to retrieve messages from a server running
the Network News Transfer Protocol (NNTP) as defined in RFC977 . It returns 
an array whose structure depends on the command parameter, thus:
nntp_get()
command
Examples: create table my_news (m_id integer, m_group varchar, m_text long varchar,
create procedure get_my_news (in server varchar, in grp varchar)
